def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0}
    if len(colors) < 2:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Find the enclosing non-background rectangle and identify its interior color.
    cells = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
    outer=grid[r0][c0]
    inner=next((grid[r][c] for r,c in cells if grid[r][c] != outer), outer)
    # The distinct inner color spreads outward from the framed rectangle by the
    # thickness of the outer-color border around it.
    ir0=min(r for r,c in cells if grid[r][c] == inner)
    ir1=max(r for r,c in cells if grid[r][c] == inner)
    ic0=min(c for r,c in cells if grid[r][c] == inner)
    ic1=max(c for r,c in cells if grid[r][c] == inner)
    t=min(ir0-r0, r1-ir1, ic0-c0, c1-ic1)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(max(0,r0-t), min(h,r1+t+1)):
        for c in range(max(0,c0-t), min(w,c1+t+1)):
            if r < r0 or r > r1 or c < c0 or c > c1:
                out[r][c]=inner
    return out
if __name__ == '__main__':
    g=[[0]*21 for _ in range(21)]
    for r in range(6,12):
        for c in range(5,11): g[r][c]=3
    for r in range(7,11):
        for c in range(6,10): g[r][c]=8
    z=transform(g)
    for row in z: print(*row)
